name: Mephibosheth
bio: Mephibosheth was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah — sharing his name with, but entirely distinct from, Jonathan's crippled son whom David showed kindness. When a three-year famine struck Israel and the LORD revealed it was due to Saul's bloodguilt against the Gibeonites, David handed over seven of Saul's descendants for the Gibeonites to execute; this Mephibosheth and his brother Armoni were among them, put to death at the beginning of the barley harvest. Jonathan's son Mephibosheth was spared only because of David's oath with Jonathan (2 Samuel 21:1-9).
